verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents delegating tasks to agent sessions from inside its app: you create a task, choose a workflow, and ask the session agent to act, for example to open a draft PR. The agent itself is an external harness (Claude Code, Codex, or one you bring), not a native built-in assistant, so the story's "built-in AI assistant" element is only partly met. missing for 10: a first-party native assistant rather than externally installed agent backends, and independent or hands-on corroboration of in-product delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Ask the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view.
